HOW IT WORKS

A clear workflow from start to finish

Inventory can be enabled per item so stock-aware products remain connected to sales quantities without forcing stock tracking onto services.

01

Configure the item

Add its unit, sale and purchase price, tax, and opening stock.

02

Enable inventory

Turn on stock management for products that require quantity tracking.

03

Set a reorder level

Define the threshold used to identify low-stock items.

04

Review availability

Check current and projected stock while preparing sales documents.

KEY CAPABILITIES

Everything you need for this workflow

Per-item inventory

Enable stock control only for relevant products.

Opening and current stock

Maintain a visible quantity baseline and current position.

Reorder levels

Set a practical par level for replenishment decisions.

Projected availability

Compare available stock with quantities being invoiced.

Low-stock warnings

Highlight products approaching or crossing their threshold.

Item organization

Use units, categories, prices, tax, images, and notes.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Questions about inventory tracking

Do services require inventory tracking?

No. Inventory management can be enabled per item.

Can I set a reorder level?

Yes. Items can use a reorder or par level for low-stock visibility.

Does invoicing affect stock?

The audited feature set includes inventory adjustment from invoice quantities.

Can projected stock become negative?

The application is designed to warn about low or negative projected availability.
